name: kern-sandbox
description: Your model writes the code. This runs it where it can't touch your machine: a rootless Linux container, no daemon, no VM, no cloud, no account. A kernel boundary, not a microVM: for deliberately hostile code, use one.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "for (const a of ['x64', 'arm64']) if (!require('fs').existsSync('bin/linux-' + a + '/kern')) { console.error('kern-sandbox: bin/linux-' + a + '/kern is missing. Publish the tarball build-package.py writes, not this directory.'); process.exit(1) }"
